exercises.name: Triceps Extension (Machine)

source_english.description: Triceps Extension (Machine) uses a seated lever pad and fixed handles to flex and extend the elbows.
instructions: Sit against the machine back pad with feet planted and handles held above the chest.
Grip the machine handles with an overhand grip and keep the upper arms fixed beside or above the torso.
Bend the elbows to lower the resistance to the forehead or behind the head.
Pause at the endpoint, then extend the elbows to return to straight arms.
source_english.safety_note: Use a load you can lower slowly and keep clear space around the head.

source_english.description: Lat Pulldown - Close Grip (Cable) pulls the band, cable bar, or machine handles from overhead toward the upper chest while the torso stays braced.
instructions: Set the cable seat and knee pad, then attach a close-grip handle.
Sit tall with the knees secured and grip the handle with a neutral or close overhand grip.
Pull the elbows down toward the ribs until the handle reaches the upper chest.
Pause briefly, then return the handle overhead without letting the shoulders shrug.
form_cues: Drive the elbows down and back.
Keep the handle close to the torso.
source_english.safety_note: Use a comfortable grip and stop before the shoulders are forced into painful overhead range.

source_english.description: Rear Delt Reverse Fly (Cable) moves the arms outward and back through a controlled rear-delt fly arc while standing at the cable with a slight hip hinge.
instructions: Attach a D-handle to each low pulley cable and stand in the middle of the cable crossover machine.
Grasp the handles with a pronated grip (palms facing down) and take a step forward, positioning your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly and lean forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and your abs engaged.
With your arms extended out to the sides and slightly bent at the elbows, exhale and squeeze your shoulder blades together as you pull the cables back and upward in a reverse fly motion.
Pause for a moment at the peak contraction, then inhale and slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
source_english.safety_note: Use light resistance and stop if the shoulder cannot move smoothly.

source_english.description: With the rope overhead and elbows soft, pull it down to the thighs using shoulder extension and the lats.
instructions: Attach the rope to the highest cable setting and stand facing the machine.
Hold the rope with soft elbows and arms extended toward the pulley.
Pull the rope down to the thighs while keeping the arms nearly straight.
Pause, then return the rope overhead under control.
form_cues: Keep the ribs stacked and shoulders down.
Drive the elbows toward the torso.
Control the return to the start.
